objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Get into the Tomcat Manager, deploy an application of your own, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The Manager is at /manager/html. Whoever set it up did not pick a strong password; Tomcat's default example credentials are a good start.
A deployed WAR runs as the server. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Identify the server
steps.prompt: Which Tomcat major version answers? (major version)

steps.title: Find the entry point
steps.prompt: Which bundled Tomcat application deploys new applications? (name)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness lets you log in? (two words)

steps.title: Name the format
steps.prompt: In which archive format is a web application deployed? (acronym)
